# Documentation Assets

This directory stores repository documentation assets.

## Product Screenshots

Product screenshot placeholders live in
[`product-screenshots/`](./product-screenshots/). The files are PNG placeholders
referenced by the root README and the English/Chinese installation guides.
Replace the placeholder PNG files with real product screenshots using the same
filenames to keep documentation links stable.

## 文档资源

本目录用于存放仓库文档资源。

产品截图占位图位于 [`product-screenshots/`](./product-screenshots/)。这些
PNG 文件已被根 README、英文安装指南和中文安装指南引用。后续替换真实产品截图时，
建议保持文件名不变，直接覆盖同名 PNG 文件即可。
